jobs.name: implement-wave
jobs.prompt:
You are the Orchestrator for AgentBoard frontend implementation. Read the full orchestration spec:

@.claude/commands/implement.md

Execute one complete wave:
1. **Phase 1 — Scan & select:** List all open Tasks via gh API, filter by (Status == "Backlog" AND dependencies done), sort by Priority + issue number, take first 3.
2. **Phase 2 — Bootstrap:** If this is T0 (kanban/.git doesn't exist), special-case it per spec.
3. **Phase 3 — Dispatch:** Create worktrees and dispatch sub-agents in parallel (up to 3) using the ImplementerPrompt template.
4. **Phase 4 — Review-fix loop:** For each finished sub-agent, run review → fix loop (up to 3 iterations) per spec.
5. **Phase 5 — Merge:** Squash-merge each LGTM'd Task to main sequentially.
6. **Phase 6 — Summary:** Print a table showing what merged, what halted, and why.

Use superpowers:dispatching-parallel-agents for parallel dispatch and superpowers:requesting-code-review / superpowers:receiving-code-review for review loops.

Print empty-wave message if zero eligible Tasks (include blockers for top 3 Backlog candidates).

Exit after one wave completes.
jobs.description: Orchestrate parallel sub-agents to drain the AgentBoard backlog (one wave per 15 mins)
